attribution.modifications: Original texture-free flat-colour geometry on the BAG footprint (CC0) with 3DBAG LoD2.2 heights and the 3DBAG shell for the roofs and the hotel podium and tower in the same pand (CC BY 4.0): the red tile podium with its ramps and ribbon windows, the glass hall under the dark roof slab and its pale-green fascia lettered Muziekgebouw, the pale-green foyer box, and the dark Bimhuis box lettered BIMHUIS, cantilevered on two concrete columns with V struts. Measured from Gemeente Amsterdam panoramas (CC BY 4.0). No pixels or meshes imported.
